summary: Iteration 4 full-stack testing: verified new /api/generate_tokens_bulk, /api/verify_token, token_hash/token_signature binding on /api/generate_token, plus new /verify public page and rewritten Tokens screen with sub-tabs, bulk mode, camera source, and vault. 23/23 backend pytest cases pass. All frontend flows validated (happy verify, tampered token, prefill via query params, back-link, sub-tabs, bulk with 3 items, camera fallback, vault locked→create). No runtime errors.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is at ~786 lines — approaching the 700-line split threshold; consider extracting token/verify endpoints into a separate module.
verify_token accepts negative block_id and returns block_not_found (200 valid=false). Fine, but Pydantic ge=0 constraint on VerifyTokenRequest.block_id would give a cleaner 422.
TokensScreen.jsx is 795 lines — consider splitting GenerateView / VaultView into separate files.
vault.js uses localStorage under a fixed key; if two users share a browser they'd overwrite each other's vault (documented limitation, not a bug).
seed_data_creation: None — tests use fresh generate_token calls
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 4 is clean. All 23 new pytest cases in test_verify_and_bulk.py pass (bulk validation, verify happy + all failure reasons: block_not_found, block_is_not_a_token_block, token_hash_mismatch; token binding hash+signature; regression across all 6 token types & core endpoints). Frontend /verify route works standalone (no bottom nav), query-param prefill works, sub-tabs (generate/vault) function, bulk mode produces batch panel with correct testids, camera flow gracefully fails in headless and falls back to SYS. Vault locked state shows 'Create Vault' when no vault exists and disables unlock button on empty passphrase.
